1.e4 c6 2.d4 d5 3.Bd3 Nf6 4.e5 Nfd7 5.e6.strategy: A trap gambit: the pawn attacks f7 and d7, and taking it with the f-pawn loses by force (Qh5+ g6, Bxg6+ hxg6, Qxg6 mate). Against careful play it is only a pawn given away, so the idea works as a trap rather than as an opening plan.
1.e4 c6 2.d4 d5 3.Bd3 Nf6 4.e5 Nfd7 5.e6.name: Caro–Kann Defence: Mieses Attack, Landau Gambit
